name: Process
about: Starter for a knowledge map of one way of working. Generic headings only: rename, delete and fill them. Everything it adds comes in "to verify".

items.title: Purpose
items.notes: Why the process exists and what a good result looks like.

items.title: When it starts
items.notes: What starts it, and what must be ready before the first step.

items.title: Inputs
items.notes: The information, documents and approvals needed, and where each one comes from.

items.title: Steps
items.notes: One branch per step, in order. Under a step: who does it, how long it usually takes, and what it hands on.

items.title: Roles
items.notes: Who takes part and what each role decides or does.

items.title: Outputs
items.notes: What the process produces, who receives it, and in what form.

items.title: Checks
items.notes: What is checked, by whom and when, before the result is used.

items.title: Exceptions and escalation
items.notes: What happens when something does not fit the normal way, and who decides.

items.title: Common issues
items.notes: Problems seen before, with what caused them and what fixed them.
